title: v18 completed read-only expert artifact audit
persistenceBasis: Retrospective record of the already completed audit; no checks rerun for this write. Actual tool stdout and command description are preserved below. No separate command or log file existed.

execution.commandBodyDescription: Inline Python read JSON/NPZ files, computed SHA256 values, recomputed train-only prototype vectors and all G/H/I representative selection scores/IDs/angles, and used assertions. No file writes, image rendering, encoder inference, generator calls, label changes or saved weight fitting.

hashAndEqualityChecks.inputLock: Recomputed all file SHA256 values listed in v18-input-lock.json and matched them.
hashAndEqualityChecks.queryProvenance: Matched metadata catalog/query-NPZ/encoder-audit/renderer-code/protocol/retrieval-code hashes to actual file bytes; matched selection metadata source/catalog/query/query-metadata/road-feature/checkpoint hashes.
hashAndEqualityChecks.encoderScope: Recomputed eight local snapshot file hashes against the prior v12 disk audit: config.json, merges.txt, preprocessor_config.json, pytorch_model.bin, special_tokens_map.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, vocab.json. Snapshot ID matched query metadata.
hashAndEqualityChecks.viewsAndOrdering: Query keys matched all25 catalog keys in order; query shape25x512, road features1003x4x512; finite query vectors and per-query L2 norm within3e-4. Metadata referenceViews1/referenceViewIndex0/roadCacheViews4 checked. Road rows aligned by frozen source positional order and hashes, not embedded IDs.
hashAndEqualityChecks.sourceCopies: Each geometry/hand/image output retained source.results exactly, all1003 original rows. Each had75 reviewSlots.
hashAndEqualityChecks.checkpoint: Canonical0 checkpoint metadata,512x32 prototype shape, and checkpoint training dataset/features hashes matched the frozen v12 dataset/cache.

independentRecomputation.prototype: Loaded original sketch per-view features as float64. For each of32 class indices, averaged ONLY records with split=train using view0, normalized each class mean, transposed to512x32, and compared all saved prototype columns with np.allclose(atol=1e-12,rtol=0). No train/val/test resplit or weight update was saved.
independentRecomputation.commonPool: For every area/target request, independently grouped source rows by geometryKey, chose minimum source ID per geometry, and sorted representatives by ID BEFORE scoring. Total representative count453, common to all three methods.
independentRecomputation.scores: G: original generatorSimilarity. H: normalized road view0 dot normalized target prototype column selected through frozen class key/alias. I: normalized road view0 dot normalized keyed original-template query. Recomputed each top1 by descending score then lexical sourceID; score equality tolerance1e-12.
independentRecomputation.selection: All75 IDs/request identities, validRoad flags, score types, scores and canonical rotation=(-source.generatorPlacement.rotDeg)%360 matched each output. No class/margin gate was applied.
independentRecomputation.fallback: Exactly three H rocket requests used G scoring/selection; fallback flags and geometry score type checked. No other missing H target permitted.

metadataLegacyLimit: Some slot-level selection text is inherited historical v11 generator-first metadata. The v18 selection object method plus slot.selectionReason, retrievalScore, scoreType and handQueryFallback describe the actual v18 policy. This audit does not rewrite frozen outputs or interpret inherited text as a second active ranking rule.
limitations: No image pixels were viewed and no AI semantic reviews were read. No new model parameters were introduced.

Query embeddings were not re-extracted and encoder inference was not rerun; correctness of rendering calls was assessed through prior code review plus source hashes, not independent image reproduction.
Matching local disk files to the v12 audit is disk provenance, not an attestation of past in-memory encoder weights. The original road cache has revision=null.
NPZ arrays lack embedded source IDs; road feature identity uses frozen JSON order plus byte hashes.
This audit did not rerun road graph/native/projected validity checks; it checked exact preservation of the previously audited source rows and coordinates.
H and I selecting the same human-confirmed development case does not establish an IMAGE-specific effect. No semantic or human performance claim follows from this numerical audit.
No checks rerun while writing this retrospective audit artifact; the recorded execution chunk and stdout are the provenance rather than an invented command-log path.
